purpose: Aggressive paper-only experiment sleeve for AIFundOS. This is for learning, not live trading.
promotion_rules: Experiments must be tagged by family and source.
Main portfolio rules are unchanged until the experiment family has at least 20 reviewed samples.
Options experiments are paper-only until liquidity, bid/ask spread, IV, and greeks are execution-grade.
Defined-risk options only; maximum loss must be known before entry.
Every experiment must record a lesson at close.
